whyThisMatters.title: We are the employer, the sponsor, and the accountable party, in the same legal entity.
whyThisMatters.description: Most EOR providers route visa applications through a local partner. Jackson & Frank holds recognised sponsor status directly in all 17+ markets we operate in, which means when something needs to happen, one entity is responsible for it.

paragraphs: Most EOR providers operate through partner networks. When they say they cover 100+ countries, they mean they know someone in those countries who is the actual legal employer and recognised sponsor. When something goes wrong, it's that partner's problem, not theirs.

Jackson & Frank holds recognised sponsor status directly in every market we operate in. We are the legal employer. We are the recognised sponsor. When we file your hire's work permit, we're filing it under our own licence, not routing it through a third party.
That matters for two reasons: your hire's permit is in stronger hands, and your liability exposure sits with a single accountable provider.
differentiator.quote: We are the employer, the sponsor, and the accountable party, in the same legal entity.

competitor.label: Typical EOR + immigration (competitor model)
competitor.description: EOR provider employs your hire in market A. For visa sponsorship, they route the application through a local immigration partner. Two contracts. Two liable parties. If there's a delay or a compliance gap, the question is whose problem it is.

jf.label: Jackson & Frank model
jf.description: Jackson & Frank employs your hire AND holds recognised sponsor status in that market. The same legal entity files the permit, runs payroll, and manages the employment relationship. One contract. One accountable party. No handoff.

process.title: From offer accepted to visa approved

steps.title: Assess
steps.description: We review your hire's nationality, role, and target market to identify the right permit category and flag any complexity early.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.description: We compile the required documentation and handle all correspondence with local immigration authorities: IND, BAMF, DIRECCTE, or the relevant body in your market.

steps.title: Submit
steps.description: As the recognised sponsor, we submit the application under our own licence. Your hire doesn't need to engage government bodies independently.

steps.title: Track
steps.description: We keep you updated throughout. No chasing required. You'll hear from us before you need to ask.

steps.title: Onboard
steps.description: Once approved, employment and payroll start through the same entity. Nothing needs to be handed off to another provider.

items.question: Is immigration sold as a separate service?
items.answer: Immigration at Jackson & Frank is handled as part of your EOR engagement, not as a standalone product. When we're your legal employer in a market, we're already the recognised sponsor, so immigration support is a natural extension of the same relationship. If you're new to Jackson & Frank, the best starting point is a conversation about EOR scope, and we'll include immigration in that discussion.

items.question: How long does the process take?
items.answer: It depends on the country's immigration authority and the permit type. In the Netherlands, Highly Skilled Migrant permits typically process in 2-4 weeks through the IND. Most other markets run from 4 weeks upward, some are faster, some (particularly non-EU markets or complex intra-company cases) take longer. We'll give you a realistic estimate for your specific market during the initial scoping call.

items.question: What's the difference between using Jackson & Frank and using a standalone immigration firm?
items.answer: A standalone immigration firm can file paperwork, but they're not the employer, so they can't be the recognised sponsor. They'll either work through your company's existing entity or route through a local partner. With Jackson & Frank, the same legal entity that employs your hire also sponsors the visa. One accountable provider, one file, one relationship.

items.question: Do you handle family visas and dependent permits?
items.answer: Yes. Dependent family member permits are part of the service in all 17+ markets. We include them in the scoping conversation when the hire's family situation is relevant.

items.question: What if the hire needs a permit renewal later?
items.answer: Renewals are handled through the same relationship. We track expiry dates and flag renewal timelines proactively, you don't need to manage a separate reminder process.

items.question: What markets do you cover?
items.answer: We hold recognised sponsor status in 17+ markets through owned legal entities: Belgium, China, Czech Republic, France, Germany, Hong Kong, Hungary, India, Italy, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Spain, Sweden, UAE, and the UK. For hiring beyond these markets at scale (typically 20+ employees), we can discuss our partner network.

items.question: Is this service for individuals looking for visa-sponsored jobs?
items.answer: No, Jackson & Frank works with companies, not individual job seekers. If you're looking for a role with visa sponsorship, you'd need to apply directly to employers who hold recognised sponsor status in the country you're targeting.
